question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "are."**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this sentence, the subject is "81 species of birds" **which is a plural subject.
 
• According to the subject-verb agreement, a singular subject takes a singular verb, and a plural subject takes a plural verb.
 
• So, **"was and is"** are opted out.
 
• The given passage is talking about the present scene, so **"are"** is the correct answer.
 
• The correct answer is option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

There are over 9000 species of birds on this planet out__ of which over 1360 are found in India alone. 81 species of birds __**are**__ endemic to India. Because birds are found everywhere, and in all ______ (3) ______ zones, their sizes, shapes and wings are ______ (4) ______ according to the needs of their habitat. For instance, eagles and hawks have massive soaring wings with primary feather that ______ (5) ______ out and allow them to soar high in the sky.
